name: genesis-prompt-kit

exports.ROLE_CONTRACTS: Planner, worker and reviewer role contracts.
exports.TEACHING_CONTRACT: Pattern, invariant, counterexample and acceptance teaching contract.
exports.LIMITS: Hard bounds for text, arrays and numeric budgets.
exports.createTaskContract: Build and strictly validate a task contract.
exports.validateTaskContract: Return {ok, errors} for the entire contract object.
exports.assertTaskContract: Throw on any schema or bound violation.
exports.renderPrompt: Render system, project, role, teaching, repository or task prompt text.
exports.renderTaskContract: Render a validated task contract for a worker.
exports.parseTaskContract: Parse and validate JSON task-contract text.

cli: node index.cjs render <kind> [--role planner] or node index.cjs validate <contract.json>
privacy: No vendor prompts, private corpora, credentials, model weights or machine-specific paths are included.
